name: COSCO SHIPPING International (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd.
summary: COSCO SHIPPING International (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd. is an investment holding company providing shipping-related services in Hong Kong, China and elsewhere. Its business lines include coatings, marine equipment, ship trading, insurance brokerage, intelligent shipping and general trading. It acts as agent for shipbuilding, ship trading and bareboat chartering, and offers voyage repairs.
